<quote source="d:3727" n="9.135cd"><l>rgyu'i dus na 'bras gnas na ||</l> <l>zas sogs mi gtsang za bar thal ||</l></quote><note type="editorial">The canonical translation reads: gal te rgyu la 'bras gnas na || zan za mi gtsang za ar 'gyur</note> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5972">zhang g.ye</rs></note> zhes pa'i nyes pa yang med de der ni bskyed bya dang skyed byed du 'dod pa'i lugs la skyon <lb edRef="inst:4622" n="59b4"/> gsungs la |</seg></TEI>
